name: GX250 Edge & Compact Floor Grinder
summary: Portable 250 mm single-phase grinder for edges, corners and tight spaces.
description: A compact single-head grinder for the places larger machines can't reach: wall edges, around columns, and through narrow doorways. It runs on single-phase power, with a soft start that helps avoid tripped breakers on weak site supplies. It is used for concrete profiling, coating and epoxy removal and surface preparation. It breaks down quickly for transport in a car.

name: Trapezoid Diamond Grinding Shoes
summary: Metal-bond diamond segments on quick-change trapezoid plates for planetary floor grinders.
description: Twin metal-bond diamond segments on a trapezoid plate that clips onto the heads of planetary floor grinders. Used to grind and level concrete, remove coatings and adhesives, and open up terrazzo before resin polishing. Choose the bond to suit the hardness of the concrete.
features: Bonds for soft, medium and hard concrete

name: Segmented Diamond Grinding Disc
summary: Metal-bond segmented disc for single-head floor and edge grinders.
description: A steel disc with a full ring of metal-bond diamond segments, for single-head floor and edge grinders. It is used for fast concrete grinding, levelling and coating removal.

name: Abtex Floor Polishing & Buffing Pads
summary: Non-woven floor pads in colour-coded grades for scrubbing, buffing and polishing.
description: Abtex non-woven pads for single-disc machines and scrubbers. The colours mark the job, from aggressive cleaning and stripping to gentle buffing and polishing. Use them for daily maintenance, crystallising and bringing up the shine on stone and terrazzo floors.

name: Stornello Sander
summary: Compact Italian sanding and polishing machine for edges, steps and small areas.
description: The Stornello from Künzle & Tasin is a compact, easy-to-handle machine for sanding and polishing where large floor machines can't work: along edges, on steps and landings, and in small rooms. Ask us which version suits stone or wood.
